method: Native SVG variations of the preferred Focus Iris and Orbit Lens, using controlled geometry and repeated curves.

variants.name: Rounded iris
variants.summary: Smoother four-blade iris with a balanced central opening.

variants.name: Diamond iris
variants.summary: A compact four-blade aperture on a diagonal axis.

variants.name: Open iris
variants.summary: Airier square iris with a larger optical opening.

variants.name: Balanced orbit
variants.summary: Broad symmetrical crescents with a calm circular envelope.

variants.name: Swept orbit
variants.summary: Two flowing crescents with a more directional oval envelope.

variants.name: Split optic
variants.summary: A compact two-lobe optical mark with simple symmetrical cuts.
